summary: Boise NF ground site on Grays (North) Peak: 1935 cabin, abandoned in the 1950s and listed as gone; no staffing or current-site description in sources.

facts.design: Cabin (no design letter or structure details given in the sources)
facts.status_note: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts call it Gone; the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Idaho list says Abandoned; no source describes the site today

visit.trail_note: Listed as a hike-in site by Idaho Fire Lookouts

events.note: Cabin, per Kresek as cited by Forest Lookouts; firelookout.com gives the same year

evidence.supports: Idaho list: Grays (North) Peak, Valley County, ground type, status Abandoned

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Fire Lookout Association's Idaho list gives Abandoned. firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give Gone. The story reports Gone from the two site pages and notes the list's wording.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 1935 date rests on one underlying source (Kresek) repeated across three sites. No staffing, fire, or current-site information found. Brief checked: Valley County, lat/long, ground type and gone all match. Name variants: Grays (North) Peak and Gray's Peak (North). Story is short because the evidence is short.
